criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Creation
categories.definition: One entity is the creator, author, designer, developer, inventor, architect, or manufacturer of the other entity.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: One entity's physical position, geographical origin, or home base is defined by the other.

categories.name: Membership/Affiliation
categories.definition: One entity is a part of, belongs to, or is associated with a larger group, organization, political party, team, league, military unit, or event.

categories.name: Role/Title
categories.definition: One entity holds a specific official position, title, or profession related to the other.

categories.name: Classification
categories.definition: One entity is a specific kind, category, genre, or type of the other.

categories.name: Platform/Distribution
categories.definition: One entity serves as the medium, network, label, or distributor for the other to be accessed, published, or broadcast.

categories.name: Temporal Context
categories.definition: One entity is associated with a specific point or period in time.

categories.name: Family Relationship
categories.definition: One entity is related to the other through family ties.

categories.name: Status/Recognition
categories.definition: One entity holds a formal designation, inclusion, award, or honor in relation to the other.

categories.name: Derivation/Inspiration
categories.definition: One entity's content, form, or existence is based on, derived from, or inspired by the other.

categories.name: Related Entities
categories.definition: Two distinct entities share a direct, non-hierarchical, or sequential connection (e.g., items in a series, predecessor/successor, equivalent names, parallel concepts).

categories.name: Component of Work/Entity
categories.definition: One entity is an integral part, division, character, or element within a larger work, organization, or system.
